pages.title: The way over the spikes
pages.text: Green - the start, blue - the heart, red - the way.

Over the chasm runs a way of pillars and brittle ice, there and back. The ice breaks underfoot but grows back. Whoever falls climbs back by the ladder to the start of his row - and only there.$(br2)Over some gaps axes swing. Count their rhythm before you jump.
The maws in the walls watch the way. In time they lose patience and spit faster and faster. Do not linger.$(br2)On the far side waits the heart - and what opens the Prison Gate.
